title: At the table
subtitle: Serving and pairing Verdejo
objectives: Know how long to keep it

steps.title: Tapas and seafood
steps.body: Verdejo suits tapas, grilled fish, prawns, salads, goat's cheese and dishes with herbs. Its herbal notes match green sauces and fennel; its acidity handles fried food like calamari. In Castilla, it's the everyday white with lunch.

steps.title: Service and age
steps.body: Serve at 7 to 9 degrees. Most Verdejo is best within one to two years. Oak- or lees-aged versions, and Rueda Dorado, a traditional oxidative fortified style, can age longer.

steps.explanation: Its acidity cuts through fried food.

steps.body: Rueda Dorado, a rare traditional style aged in glass demijohns in the sun and then in barrel, shows Verdejo's oxidative past.

steps.explanation: Rich red meat needs a red.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Verdejo suits tapas, seafood and herbal dishes
